title: Genuina principia doctrinae de statu aequilibrii et motu corporum tam perfecte flesibilium quam elasticorum

errors: No errors on this page. The formulas V = (S ddφ + dS dφ)/ds² and v = S dφ ds/(S ddφ + dS dφ) follow correctly from Vv = S dφ/ds and d(Vv) = V ds with ds constant.
Euler's remark on the next page that dT can no longer be integrated directly is correct: the obstruction is the term S'κ²/2.

ideas.what: Bending moment proportional to curvature with a position-dependent stiffness S(s): M = S(s)·dφ/ds
ideas.modern_name: Euler–Bernoulli / Kirchhoff planar rod with variable flexural rigidity EI(s)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Euler (variable 'absolute elasticity' already in the 1744 Additamentum De curvis elasticis); Jakob/Daniel Bernoulli for the constant case
ideas.where_published: E65 Methodus inveniendi (1744), Additamentum I (laminae of unequal elasticity); E410 itself

ideas.what: Intrinsic equilibrium equations for tension, shear and moment along a loaded rod, specialized to variable stiffness
ideas.modern_name: Planar Kirchhoff rod balance laws (force and moment balance in the Frenet frame)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Euler, E410 (1771), as discussed by Truesdell 1960
ideas.where_published: E410; Truesdell, Rational Mechanics of Flexible or Elastic Bodies (Opera omnia II 11.2)

ideas.what: Elimination of shear and tension to obtain a fourth-order ODE for φ(s), with the observation that the tension equation loses its first integral when S varies
ideas.modern_name: Loss of the energy-like first integral (T + Sκ²/2) for non-uniform rods

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine generalization from constant to variable flexural rigidity in Euler's general rod equations. Euler treated unequal elasticity already in 1744, and E410 is analysed in detail by Truesdell. Nothing here appears absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: 'dVv' means d(V·v), the differential of the moment.
Next page: the lowercase 's' in 'dT = p ds − (s dφ ddφ + ds dφ²)/ds²' should be the capital 'S' and 'dS' (the stiffness function), i.e. (S dφ ddφ + dS dφ²)/ds².
Next page: 'T = (s d³φ + 2 ds ddφ + dds dφ)/(ds² dφ) − q ds/dφ' should read (S d³φ + 2 dS ddφ + ddS dφ)/(ds² dφ) − q ds/dφ.
